- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:codestral-2508 entry, truncation_policy field | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The codestral-2508 entry uses `"mode": "bytes"`, so truncation will occur around ~64k tokens well before the declared 256k context window.
  WHY: Both reviewers flagged the same bytes-mode truncation policy as an early cap; they also noted this matches the reviewer-only convention and is unlikely to cause a runtime failure.
- agents.md:81-88 and 106-113 | severity=low | confidence=3

  PROBLEM: The PR narrative says codestral-2508 was added to both third-party reviewer lists in `agents.md`, but the last run only changed the second list.
  WHY: This is a documentation consistency issue only, with no runtime failure expected.
- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:codestral-2508 entry, supported_reasoning_levels field | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The codestral-2508 catalog entry advertises `medium`, `high`, and `xhigh` reasoning levels but omits `low` and `none`.
  WHY: This only matters if an operator overrides `THINKING_LEVEL_REVIEWER` to an unsupported level and runtime validation rejects it; the default reviewer path is unaffected.

- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:codestral-2508 entry, truncation_policy field | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The truncation_policy uses mode "bytes" with limit 256000 (~64K tokens), while the model's context_window is 256000 tokens and auto_compact_token_limit is 184000 tokens.
  WHY: The bytes-mode limit will trigger before auto-compaction ever would; this matches the convention used by minimax/minimax-m2.5 and moonshotai/kimi-k2.5, and reviewer prompts are typically within the safe range.
- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:codestral-2508 entry, supported_reasoning_levels field | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The catalog entry lists supported reasoning levels as medium, high, xhigh — omitting low and none.
  WHY: This only becomes an issue if an operator overrides THINKING_LEVEL_REVIEWER to low or none and codex validates the level against the catalog and the provider rejects it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
